back_notes.home.use-cases.p-7: "it keeps data only in memory" - the subject of the last clause is unclear (God mode vs. the server).
back_notes.home.install.span-1: "main release" (основной выпуск) for what is probably a stable-version label; slightly ambiguous.
back_notes.home.p-appliance.li-4: "with strictly limited access" and "with no access to an external network" - fine, but "protected dedicated LLM server" is an awkward noun phrase.
back_notes.home.why-stats.p-1: "more concurrency is needed" (нужно больше параллелизма) is a terse impersonal instruction.
back_notes.home.why-cache.figcaption-4: "This is an illustration of the card" (иллюстрация карточки) - calling a real snapshot an "illustration" is an odd word choice; "touch the card" for the image.
back_notes.home.agents.span-8: "request processed locally — 99% of traffic" - the number is missing a quantity before "request" (singular "запрос") so the sentence is a fragment.
back_notes.home.why-agent.p-1: "each mistake turns into an extra download and load" - "mistake" is a surprising word for a failed trial.
back_notes.home.why-agent.li-1: Label "Study and select" (Изучить и отобрать) is a loose rendering of inventory-and-preselect.
back_notes.home.why-keys.span-4: "what remains" is an incomplete fragment; unclear what remains.
back_notes.chrome.footer.tag-note: "Cookie files are set only if you agree to it" - "agree to it" is slightly off (agree to them).
back_notes.coding-agents.flow.desc: "where its cache already lies" (лежит) is a physical-location metaphor for cache; unusual in technical Russian.
back_notes.clients.codex-cli.capability: "before stopping them" (прекратить их) - "them" refers to attempts, but "retries" is expressed with a noun; mildly awkward. "State is not saved" is also terse.
back_notes.claude-code-router.figcaption-2: Counter labels translated inconsistently: "pass-through transfers", "fallback switches", "refusals" - the nouns read as odd for request outcomes.
back_notes.claude-code-router.p-7: "Be prepared for the first step to turn out slow" and "step" for conversation turn; "from scratch" and "KV cache of fp8" are slightly clumsy.
back_notes.gpu-monitoring.p-5: "the cache is most likely already deleted" (удален) - "deleted" for cache eviction; and "Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi — without setup, Hermes and Aider — after adding one line" has dashes used ambiguously as list punctuation.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.p-7: "The server on which routing by replicas was first needed" is an odd phrase for the origin of the feature.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.figcaption-6: First sentence is elliptical: "what each replica took from the prefix cache and what had to be computed, and the share from the cache" - lacks a verb/structure.
back_notes.api-keys.p-1: "Perform rotation of a key" (Выполняйте ротацию) is a bureaucratic noun phrase; "select it with the mouse on the chart" adds detail not clearly belonging.
back_notes.api-keys.leave.h2-1: "give up LM Warden" (Отказаться от) means abandon/decline; the heading reads as a refusal rather than leaving.
back_notes.api-keys.p-4: "Read the diff below in the reverse direction" - odd instruction; "weights lie" and "packs into a tar archive" are fine but colloquial.
back_notes.features.dd-4: "In front of it you can, without changes, put..." - awkward word order; "it" is the port.
back_notes.features.dd-6: "passing to Anthropic" is vague for "forwarded"; the list structure with dashes is loose.
back_notes.faq.a-8: "(by their token id)" is a parenthetical in English letters, mixed script; "viewing one key's traffic in memory with a limited buffer size" is clumsy.
back_notes.faq.a-12: "Nothing at all" (Нисколько) answers "how much does it cost" - correct but terse; "pays for itself" implies amortization.
